akin.meaning: 1 similar or related in nature or character (often followed by to). 2 related by blood.
akin.example_en: What he felt was closer to pity, akin to sorrow.
akin.example_tl: Ang naramdaman niya ay kahawig ng malalim na kalungkutan. (What she felt was akin to deep sorrow.)

befuddle.meaning: To confuse or perplex completely; make unable to think clearly.
befuddle.example_en: The complicated instructions completely befuddled the newcomers.
befuddle.example_tl: Lubos na nilito ng magulong panuto ang mga baguhan. (The complicated instructions completely befuddled the newcomers.)

disdainful.meaning: Showing contempt or lack of respect; scornful.
disdainful.example_en: He gave a disdainful glance at the messy paperwork.
disdainful.example_tl: Tiningnan niya nang may mapanghamak na tingin ang magulong mga papel. (He gave the messy papers a disdainful look.)

drat.meaning: Used to express mild anger or annoyance.
drat.example_en: Drat, I left my keys inside the house!
drat.example_tl: Naku naman, naiwan ko sa loob ng bahay ang mga susi ko! (Drat, I left my keys inside the house!)

drat.meaning: Used as dratted: annoying or troublesome.
drat.example_en: This dratted rain won't stop falling.
drat.example_tl: Ayaw tumigil ng nakakainis na ulang ito. (This dratted rain won't stop.)

gormless.meaning: Chiefly British, informal: lacking intelligence, vitality, or awareness; foolish.
gormless.example_en: He stood there with a gormless expression on his face.
gormless.example_tl: Nakatayo lamang siya roon na tila tuliro at walang ideya sa nangyayari. (He just stood there looking gormless, with no idea what was happening.)

henceforth.meaning: From this time onward; from now on.
henceforth.example_en: Henceforth, all library books must be returned within two weeks.
henceforth.example_tl: Mula ngayon, mas maingat na siyang magpapasya. (Henceforth, she will make decisions more carefully.)

horde.meaning: A very large crowd or group of people, often moving in a disorderly way.
horde.example_en: Hordes of commuters rushed toward the train station.
horde.example_tl: Isang malaking pulutong ng mga pasahero ang nagmamadali patungo sa estasyon. (A horde of passengers rushed toward the station.)

impending.meaning: About to happen soon, especially something unpleasant or threatening.
impending.example_en: Dark clouds warned everyone of the impending storm.
impending.example_tl: Nagbabala ang maiitim na ulap tungkol sa paparating na bagyo. (Dark clouds warned of the impending storm.)

kowtow.meaning: 1 to act in an excessively obedient or submissive way to please someone powerful. 2 historically, to kneel and touch the ground with the forehead in respect.
kowtow.example_en: She refused to kowtow to unfair demands.
kowtow.example_tl: Tumanggi siyang yumukod at sumunod sa mga hindi makatarungang utos. (She refused to kowtow to unfair demands.)

kowtow.meaning: A deep bow made by kneeling and touching the forehead to the ground.
kowtow.example_en: Guests offered a respectful kowtow before the elder.
kowtow.example_tl: Nagbigay sila ng malalim na pagyukod bilang tanda ng paggalang. (They made a deep kowtow as a sign of respect.)

levity.meaning: Humor or lack of seriousness, especially during a serious or formal situation.
levity.example_en: His joke brought a brief moment of levity to the tense meeting.
levity.example_tl: Nagdala ng kaunting kagaanan ng loob ang biro niya sa seryosong pulong. (His joke brought a touch of levity to the serious meeting.)

plonk.meaning: To set, put, or drop something down heavily and carelessly.
plonk.example_en: He plonked the heavy suitcase down on the floor.
plonk.example_tl: Ibinagsak niya nang pabigla ang mabigat na maleta sa sahig. (He plonked the heavy suitcase onto the floor.)

plonk.meaning: 1 a heavy dull sound of something dropping. 2 informal, cheap or inferior wine.
plonk.example_en: The book landed with a loud plonk on the desk.
plonk.example_tl: Bumagsak ang libro nang may malakas na kalabog sa mesa. (The book landed on the desk with a loud plonk.)

predisposition.meaning: A tendency or inclination to suffer from something or behave in a particular way.
predisposition.example_en: Some families share a genetic predisposition to heart disease.
predisposition.example_tl: May likas na hilig siyang maging mahinahon kahit sa oras ng krisis. (She has a natural predisposition to stay calm even in a crisis.)

purveyor.meaning: A person or business that sells or supplies food, goods, or services.
purveyor.example_en: The shop is a longtime purveyor of fine coffee and pastries.
purveyor.example_tl: Matagal nang tagapagtustos ng masarap na kape ang tindahang ito. (This shop has long been a purveyor of fine coffee.)

rigmarole.meaning: A long, complicated, and annoying procedure or rambling story.
rigmarole.example_en: We had to go through the whole rigmarole of filling out ten forms.
rigmarole.example_tl: Dumaan pa kami sa mahabang pasikot-sikot bago naaprubahan ang papel. (We had to go through a whole rigmarole before the paper was approved.)

scrunch.meaning: To crush, crumple, or squeeze tightly into a smaller shape.
scrunch.example_en: She scrunched the paper into a tight ball.
scrunch.example_tl: Nilamukos niya ang papel hanggang maging bilog ito. (She scrunched the paper into a ball.)

scrunch.meaning: A crunching sound or crumpled state.
scrunch.example_en: Snow gave a loud scrunch under his boots.
scrunch.example_tl: May malakas na kaluskos sa ilalim ng kanyang sapatos. (There was a loud scrunch under his shoes.)

sheepish.meaning: Showing embarrassment or shame because you have done something silly or wrong.
sheepish.example_en: He gave a sheepish grin after knocking over the glass.
sheepish.example_tl: Ngumiti siya nang nahihiya matapos matabig ang baso. (He smiled sheepishly after knocking over the glass.)

sprawl.meaning: 1 to sit, lie, or fall with arms and legs spread out awkwardly. 2 to spread out over a wide area untidily.
sprawl.example_en: The tired dog sprawled across the cool floor.
sprawl.example_tl: Humandusay ang pagod na aso sa malamig na sahig. (The tired dog sprawled across the cool floor.)

sprawl.meaning: An untidy, irregular spread of buildings or limbs.
sprawl.example_en: Urban sprawl has reached the nearby farmland.
sprawl.example_tl: Umabot na sa mga bukirin ang mabilis na pagkalat ng lungsod. (Urban sprawl has already reached the farmlands.)

unabashed.example_en: She gave an unabashed cheer when her team scored.
unabashed.example_tl: Sumigaw siya nang walang hiya-hiya nang manalo ang kanyang koponan. (She gave an unabashed cheer when her team won.)

vigorous.meaning: 1 strong, healthy, and full of energy. 2 forceful and energetic.
vigorous.example_en: She shook her head vigorously when asked to agree.
vigorous.example_tl: Masigla niyang iniling ang kanyang ulo nang tanungin siya. (She shook her head vigorously when asked.)

agape.example_tl: Nakatunganga lamang siya habang pinapanood ang palabas. (He simply stood agape while watching the show.)

chime.meaning: 1 set of attuned bells. 2 sounds made by this.
chime.example_en: The chimes of the old clock echoed down the hall.
chime.example_tl: Umalingawngaw ang repike ng lumang orasan sa pasilyo. (The chimes of the old clock echoed down the hall.)

chime.meaning: 1 to ring melodiously as a bell or chime. 2 to interrupt or join a conversation (chimed in).
chime.example_en: The bells and gongs chimed at midnight.
chime.example_tl: Tumunog ang mga kampana pagsapit ng hatinggabi. (The bells chimed at midnight.)

contemplate.meaning: To think about whether you should do something, or how you should do something.
contemplate.example_en: You're too young to be contemplating retirement.
contemplate.example_tl: Bata ka pa para pag-isipan ang pagreretiro. (You're too young to be contemplating retirement.)

derogatory.example_tl: Nakakasakit ang kanyang mga mapanlait na salita. (His derogatory remarks are hurtful.)

dignified.example_tl: Nanatili siyang marangal at mahinahon sa harap ng pagsubok. (She remained dignified and calm in the face of hardship.)

dread.example_en: I fear the winters in Moscow.
dread.example_tl: Nang magkagayo'y sinabi ko sa inyo, Huwag kayong mangilabot ni matakot sa kanila. (Then I said unto you, Dread not, neither be afraid of them.)

dread.example_en: The student looked around the examination room with apprehension.
dread.example_tl: Hindi ba kayo tatakutin ng kaniyang karilagan, at ang gulat sa kaniya ay sasa inyo? (Shall not his excellency make you afraid? and his dread fall upon you?)

Ang Panginoon ng mga hukbo, siya ang inyong aariing banal; at sumakaniya ang inyong takot, at sumakaniya ang inyong pangingilabot. (Sanctify the Lord of hosts himself; and let him be your fear, and let him be your dread.)

feasible.example_en: Your plan sounds feasible enough to try.
feasible.example_tl: Mukhang posible at maisasagawa ang iyong plano. (Your plan seems feasible and doable.)

fire.meaning: The flames, light and heat, and often smoke, that are produced when something burns.
fire.example_en: Don't forget to put out the fire.

fire.meaning: To shoot bullets, etc. from a gun or other weapon; to dismiss somebody from their job.
fire.example_en: The soldiers fired into the air as a warning.
fire.example_tl: Nagpaputok sa ere ang mga sundalo bilang babala. (The soldiers fired into the air as a warning.)

glisten.meaning: Shine like a wet or polished surface.
glisten.example_en: The doe's eyes glistened in the morning light.
glisten.example_tl: Ang napakalayong araw ay sumikat nang mahina sa mga mayelong larang at kabundukan ng malayong Pluto. (The very distant sun shone faintly on the ice fields and mountains of faraway Pluto.)

glisten.example_en: The doe's eyes glistened in the morning light.
glisten.example_tl: Nagniningning ang mga bituin sa langit. (Stars shine above in the sky.)

palpable.meaning: 1 able to be touched or felt. 2 readily perceived.
palpable.example_en: The tension in the room was palpable.
palpable.example_tl: Ramdam na ramdam ang tensiyon sa loob ng silid. (The tension inside the room was palpable.)

perch.meaning: 1 bar, branch, etc. used by a bird to rest on. 2 high place for a person or thing to rest on. 3 hist. measure of length, especially for land, of 51/2 yards.
perch.example_en: The bird hopped down from its high perch.
perch.example_tl: Lumapag ang ibon sa mataas na sangang dapuan nito. (The bird landed on its high perch.)

perch.meaning: Settle or rest on or as on a perch etc.
perch.example_en: The birds perched high in the tree.
perch.example_tl: Dumapo ang mga ibon sa mataas na puno. (The birds perched high in the tree.)

pique.example_en: His temper sparked like damp firewood.
pique.example_tl: Umalis siya nang may sama ng loob dahil sa nangyari. (He left in a fit of pique over what happened.)

pique.meaning: 1 to arouse interest or curiosity. 2 to offend or irritate someone's pride.
pique.example_en: The strange clue piqued her curiosity.
pique.example_tl: Pinukaw ng kakaibang palatandaan ang kanyang pagkamausisa. (The strange clue piqued her curiosity.)

pragmatic.meaning: Dealing with matters from a practical point of view.
pragmatic.example_en: A matter-of-fact (or pragmatic) approach to the problem.
pragmatic.example_tl: Kailangan natin ng praktikal na solusyon sa problemang ito. (We need a pragmatic solution to this problem.)

pulsate.meaning: 1 expand and contract rhythmically; throb. 2 vibrate, quiver, thrill.
pulsate.example_en: The city pulsated with music and excitement.
pulsate.example_tl: Ang lungsod ay tumibok sa musika at kasabikan. (The city pulsated with music and excitement.)

scowl.example_en: He greeted the visitor with an angry scowl.
She scowled at the noisy crowd outside.
scowl.example_tl: Sumimangot siya nang makita ang magulong silid. (She scowled when she saw the messy room.)

retort.example_en: It brought a sharp rejoinder from the teacher.
retort.example_tl: Nagbigay siya ng mabilis at matalim na sagot sa paratang. (She gave a quick and sharp retort to the accusation.)

retort.meaning: 1 say by way of a retort; make a retort. 2 repay (an insult or attack) in kind.
retort.example_en: She retorted angrily when blamed for the mistake.
retort.example_tl: Sumagot siya nang pabalang nang sisihin siya sa pagkakamali. (She retorted angrily when blamed for the mistake.)

square.meaning: Having four straight equal sides and four angles of 90°.
square.example_tl: May apat na sulok ang parisukat.

square.meaning: A shape with four straight sides of equal length and four angles of 90°; a piece of something that has this shape.
square.example_en: Robert Hooke, a biologist from England, saw small squares in cork with a microscope.
square.example_tl: Nakita ni Robert Hooke, isang biologo mula sa Inglatera, ang mga maliliit na parisukat sa tapon gamit ang mikroskopyo.

square.meaning: 1 squarely (hit me square on the jaw). 2 fairly, honestly.
square.example_en: She faced the difficult problem squarely.
square.example_tl: Hinarap niya nang tuwiran ang mabigat na problema. (She faced the difficult problem squarely.)

throb.meaning: 1 pulsate, especially with more than the usual force or rapidity. 2 vibrate with a persistent rhythm or with emotion.
throb.example_tl: Tumitibok nang mabilis at kumikirot ang ulo ko. (My head is throbbing rapidly.)

throb.example_en: I felt a throb in my head.
throb.example_tl: Na ito'y hindi magiging kalumbayan sa iyo o kutog man ng loob sa aking panginoon, maging ikaw ay nagbubo ng dugo sa walang kabuluhan, o gumanti ng sa kaniyang sarili ang aking panginoon: at pagka gumawa ang Panginoon ng mabuti sa aking panginoon, alalahanin mo nga ang iyong lingkod. (That this shall be no grief unto thee, nor offence of heart unto my lord, either that thou hast shed blood causeless, or that my lord hath avenged himself: but when the Lord shall have dealt well with my lord, then remember thine handmaid.)

tutelage.meaning: 1 guardianship or protection. 2 instruction or guidance under a tutor.
tutelage.example_en: Under her teacher's tutelage, she quickly mastered the piano.
tutelage.example_tl: Sa ilalim ng paggabay ng kanyang guro, mabilis siyang natuto. (Under her teacher's tutelage, she learned quickly.)

yelp.meaning: Sharp shrill cry as of a dog in pain or excitement.
yelp.example_en: The yelp pierced the silent night sky and made its way through the streets of Chicago.
yelp.example_tl: Nakarinig kami ng matinis na tili ng aso mula sa labas. (We heard a sharp yelp from a dog outside.)

aide.meaning: 1 a person whose job is to help someone important, such as a government official, an officer, or a leader. 2 in the US, a person who assists a teacher or a nurse.
aide.example_en: The president met with his senior aides before the announcement.
aide.example_tl: Nakipagpulong ang pangulo sa kanyang mga mataas na katulong bago ang anunsyo. (The president met with his senior aides before the announcement.)

betterment.meaning: The act or process of improving something; the state of being made better, especially a person's character, condition, or standard of living.
betterment.example_en: The new program aims at the betterment of the whole community.
betterment.example_tl: Layunin ng bagong programa ang pagpapabuti ng buong komunidad. (The new program aims at the betterment of the whole community.)

enclave.meaning: A country, area, or group of people that is surrounded by, or is very different from, the country, area, or people around it.
enclave.example_en: The old town remained a quiet enclave in the middle of the busy city.
enclave.example_tl: Ang lumang bayan ay nanatiling tahimik na enklabe sa gitna ng abalang lungsod. (The old town remained a quiet enclave in the middle of the busy city.)

fiefdom.meaning: 1 an area of land controlled by a lord under the feudal system; a fief. 2 disapproving: an organization, department, or business that one person controls completely and does not allow others to influence.
fiefdom.example_en: Each manager guarded his own fiefdom and shared nothing with the others.
fiefdom.example_tl: Iniingatan ng bawat manedyer ang sarili niyang lupang sakop at walang ibinahagi sa iba. (Each manager guarded his own fiefdom and shared nothing with the others.)

hypothetical.meaning: 1 based on or involving an idea or a suggested situation that has not been proved or has not yet happened; supposed rather than actual. 2 of a question: asked to make people think or to discuss possibilities.
hypothetical.example_en: Let's consider a hypothetical case where the market crashes tomorrow.
hypothetical.example_tl: Isipin natin ang isang kathang-isip na sitwasyon kung saan biglang bumagsak ang merkado bukas. (Let's consider a hypothetical case where the market crashes tomorrow.)

hypothetical.meaning: Used as hypothetically: in a way based on an imagined situation or possibility rather than on facts.
hypothetical.example_en: Hypothetically, we could finish by Friday if nothing goes wrong.
hypothetical.example_tl: Kung sakali, matatapos natin ito bago mag-Biyernes kung walang magiging problema. (Hypothetically, we could finish by Friday if nothing goes wrong.)
